## Invitations

A total of 2346 invitations were issued for the outreach activity. Attendance was 449, representing a rate of 19.1 per cent. The level of attendance has been recorded for monitoring and future planning. Local arrangements were maintained to support access for people who wished to attend, with services delivered where conditions permitted.

The invitation process was conducted across the Hill Counties area. Staff continued to provide information and support during the outreach period, taking account of local travel conditions and the availability of suitable routes.

## Contact

No invitations were sent by SMS, with the recorded SMS total being 0. No reminder messages were issued, and the reminder total was 0. Contact activity therefore relied on the invitation process and direct local arrangements rather than text messaging.

Van days were maintained where roads allowed. This approach supported continued delivery in locations that could be reached safely and practically. The outreach arrangements and attendance figures will inform consideration of future contact and transport planning.

Prepared by G. Evans.
